title: Park recursive numerical banks on two fixed tapes
body:
David Arias's PR2753 supplies the logical recursive BIT caller while leaving physical bank reuse open. I connect its numerical Word interface to ywz65's PR2635 parking controller: one shared parking tape and packet port preserve parent registers while descendants reuse the same fixed banks. I restore the original slot objects, values and heads, including separately owned child input grants.

The written proof covers arbitrary finite nesting with `C+4` physical tapes for `C` numerical slots. I derive the complete sequential read/write/move invoice, including slot labels, word initialization and erasure, markers, boundary probes and rewinds. I leave full caller wiring, payload/controller serialization, total reserve admission and the selected exponent unchanged.

Validation on CPython 3.12.13, standard library:

- Registered normal and optimized replays pass with complete typed receipt `c6855d4252b0af7debbe2b0050651ec269f0e060a72fd4a678080334a1b3b34b`.
- All 64 pairs of three-bit words; 1,501 nested frames and 3,750 records; 602-bit words; translated heads and opaque ancestors; labels wider than their words; copied modulus/width/depth grants.
- Eight semantic controls and five source-integrity controls, including correct values in the wrong slot and correct parent values with uncleared checkpoint cells. Exact operation formulas match the literal executions.

Only `research/selected-bit-register-parking/` is new. The three pinned predecessor files retain their bytes. I credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 Word interface, ywz65's PR2635 finite table and invoice, and David Arias's independent logical caller PR2753. Nick Petalas's PR2758/2759 storage audits remain complementary. The PR2753 source is reference text; this package does not replay the full caller.

I narrowed the concurrent logical-caller investigation in the [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18957230). The final refresh uses canonical main `8e22a9d9f621c72ab5b299061c2be4c7f638fd3c`, priority revision 5. Full overlap pagination at 20:33 covered 705 open PRs and 1,393 Discussion records; targeted reads through 20:55 found no competing physical numerical-bank codec. Metadata searches do not prove novelty.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, checks and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human, formal-kernel, hosted-CI or complete multiplication-theorem claim.
